---

Tiflan e Muslim Sajjad o Mesum Zaidi.
Muslim Ke Dono Lal Nawasay Ali Ke Hain.

1
Aks-e-Abu Turab Hain Muslim Ke Gulbadan.
Islam Ka Shabab Hain Muslim Ke Gulbadan.
Har Kufar Ka Jawab Hain Muslim Ke Gulbadan.
Tauheed Ke Ghulab Hain Muslim Ke Gulbadan.

2
Haq Ki Haqeeqaton Ka Hi Mafhoom Ho Gaye.
Do Anbiya Ke Isamo Se Mosoom Ho Gaye.
Yeh Dono Shah Zaday Hain Khilqat Ka Ik Kamal.
Farzand Hain Yeh Jis Ke Hain Aap Apni Woh Misal.

3
Chehray Mein Inn Ke Chehra e Haider Ke Khad o Khal.
Yousuf Ho Inn Ke Samne Yousuf Ki Kya Majal.
Hoon Inn Ke Robaro Tu Sitarey Bhi Maand Hain.
Muslim Ke Chand Bhi Bani Hashim Ke Chand Hain.

4
Dono Ka Husan Husan-e-Rukh-e-Kirdegar Hai.
Dono Mein Noor-e-Rab-e-Jali Jalwa Bar Hai.
Har Aik Unn Mein Husan Ka Aaina Daar Hai.
Dono Mein Aks-e-Chehra e Parwardigar Hai.

5
Kaisay Biyaan Hoon Zawiye Inn Ki Jaben Ke.
Yeh Dono Shah Zaday Hain Umm Ul-Banin Ke.
Yeh Rang Roop Kab Kissi Gul Ya Kali Ke Hain.
Yeh Nasal Hain Aqeel Ki Betay Wali Ke Hain.

6
Sheron Ka Jo Muhalla Hai Yeh Oss Ghali Ke Hain.
Abbas Ke Hain Bhanjay Nawasay Ali Ke Hain.
Islam Ki Baqa Hi Tu Inn Ka Janoon Hai.
Inn Ki Ragoon Mein Bhi Abu Talib Ka Khon Hai.

7
Inn Sa Kahin Kissi Ka Bhi Jah-o-Hasham Nahi.
Inn Ke Gharanay Jaisa Koi Mohtaram Nahi.
Hai Kaun Sa Khuda Ka Jo Inn Par Karam Nahi.
Shabbir Ko Yeh Asghar-o-Akbar Se Kam Nahi.

8
Dono Sakoon-e-Qalb-e-Payamber Ka Chain Hain.
Chashm-e-Ali Mein Yeh Bhi Hasan Our Hussain Hain.
Dono Kamal-e-Qudrat-e-Rab-e-Mobeen Hain.
Dono Dil-e-Hussain Ke Andar Maken Hain.

9
Soraj Ko Jin Pe Rashk Yeh Woh Meh Jaben Hain.
Dono Hi Bhai Husan Se Barh Kar Hasen Hain.
Kartay Yeh Hamlay Haider-e-Karrar Ki Tarha.
Lartay Tu Yeh Bhi Lartay Alamdar Ki Tarha.

Tu Ali Ki Karta Hai Humsari Yeh Tere Zameer Ki Bhool Hai.
Tujh Mein Ali Ki Wila Nahi Teri Bandagi Bhi Fazool Hai.

1
Yeh Jo Kar Raha Hai Tu Sakhtiyaan Mere Pyar Ka Hai Yeh Imtehaan.
Tujhe Takht Par Bhi Sakoon Nahi Mujhe Daar Par Bhi Mili Amaan.
Main Addo Ko Kyun Na Addo Kahon Meri Zindagi Ka Usool Hai.
Main Maron Tu Lab Pe Ho Ya Ali Mujhe Aisa Marna Qabool Hai.

2
Woh Ali Jo Hawala-e-Innama Woh Ali Jo Hasil-e-Kul Kaha.
Ossay Kiya Kahon Tu Khud Bata Chalo Tujh Pe Chora Yeh Faisla.
Jisay Haq Ne Bakhsha Hai Martaba Jo Azal Se Shohar-e-Batool Hai.
Raha Jagta Tu Imam Tha Kabhi So Gaya Tu Rasool Hai.

---

Tu Ne Bakhsha Hai Sab Ko Sahara Har Payamber Ne Tujh Ko Pukara Ali Mula.
Tu Hi Dunya Ka Mushkil Kusha Hai Bina Tere Nahi Hai Guzara.

1
Tu Jise Chahe Qanbar Bana De.
Tu Jise Chahe Buzar Bana De.
Teri Qurdat Ki Hai Yeh Karamat.
Jis Ko Chahe Qalandar Bana De.

2
Teri Marzi Pe Sab Munhisar Hai.
Saray Aalam Pe Tera Ijarah.
Koan Hai Aise Rutboon Pe Pohancha.
Tu Muhammad Ke Kandhoon Pe Pohancha.

3
Aik Hi Waqt Mein Mera Mula.
Pori Chalees Jagahoon Pe Pohancha.
La-Makaan Tu Faqat Kibriya Hai.
Kya Kahein Tum Ko Bolo Khudara.

4
Nooh Ki Hai Nijabat Ali Hai.
Our Musa Ki Haibat Ali Hai.
Sirf Taqat Nahi Hai Nabi Ki.
Hai Khuda Ki Bhi Qowat Ali Se.

5
Jab Bhi Mushkil Mein Koi Para Hai.
Kam Aaya Ali Ka Hi Narah.
Deen Ka Bool Bala Hai Tum Se.
Chand Mein Bhi Ujala Hai Tum Se.

6
De Raha Hai Yeh Quraan Gawahi.
Naam Khaliq Ka Aala Hai Tum Se.
Dobay Soraj Ko Palta De Pal Mein.
Tere Abro Ka Aik Ishara.

7
Rasm-e-Tauheed Tujh Se Chali Hai.
Tere Ghar Mein Ibadat Pali Hai.
Jis Ko Kehte Hain Sab Loag Janat.
Woh Tumhare Hi Ghar Ki Ghali Hai.

8
Teri Chokhat Ki Hai Yeh Bulandi.
Sajda Karne Ko Aaya Sitara.
Tere Dar Pe JO Pohancha Sawali.
Phir Nahi Aaya Woh Hath Khali.

9
Yeh Hadees-e-Payamber Bhi Sun Lo.
Nahi Dushman Ali Ka Halali.
:ZILL-E-SAQLAIN: Kehdo Addo.
Apna Shajrah Woh Dekhe Dobara.

Awal Ali-e-Pak Sheh-e-Khas-o-Aam Hain.
Our Dosray Hasan Sheh-e-Aali Maqam Hain.
Our Teesray Hussain Alh-e-Aslam Hain.

2
Chothey Imam Hain Mere Sajjad Dilfigar.
Our Panchwein Hain Baqir Zee Qadar Zee Wiqar.
Jafar Chatay Hain Sarwar Zee Jah Namdar.
Our Satwein Hain Musa-e-Kazim Yeh Dil Nisar.

3
Hain Aathwein Imam Raza Sarwar-e-Anam.
Aye Dil Nawein Imam Taqi Hain Buland Maqam.
Daswein Naqi Hain Girahwein Hain Askari Imam.
Our Barhwein Hain Mehdi-e-Deen Bhaij Tu Salam.

4
Din Raat Jo Bhi Wird Kare In Ke Naam Ko.
Yeh Naam Shah Karte Hain Pal Mein Ghulam Ko.
Pohanchao Subh-o-Sham Sada Iss Payam Ko.
Gar Peena Chahte Ho Jo Kausar Ke Jaam Ko.

Wali e Iran Mula Raza
Kijiye Lillah Malik Mushkilein Aasan.
Aye Ali Ke Ladlay Fatima Ki Jan.
Aap Ke Darbar Se Khali Nahi Lauta Koi.
Jo Kari Jis Ne Dua Fill Foor Woh Pori Hoi.
Khalq Ki Hajat Rawai Hai Teri Pehchan.
Aap Hai Misl-e-Ali-e-Murtaza Mushkil Kusha.
Aap Ka Darbar Hai Sab Ke Liye Bab-e-Atta.
Aap Ki Hai Badshahi Waris-e-Quran.
Khoob Langar Bat Raha Hai Aap Ki Sarkar Se.
Koi Bhoka Ja Nahi Sakta Tere Darbar Se.
Iss Qadar Mula Wasee Hai Tera Dastar Khuwan.
Jo Koi Lachar Ho Bemar Ho Mula Raza.
Aaye Woh Sehan-e-Shifa Mein Our Piye Aab-e-Baqa.
Hai Shifa Khana Tere Darbar Ka Dalaan.
Ya Raza Be-Had Hoon Sharminda Main Bad Aamal Par.
Malka-e-Qum Ke Tasaduq Ho Karam Be-Haal Par.
Hon Moafi Ka Talib Mujh Pe Kar Ahsan.
Iss Liye Main Sahib-e-Ilm-o-Hunar Hon Ya Raza.
Nam Mein:YASIR RAZA: Ke Naam Aata Hai Tera.
Main Tere Sadqay Tere Wari Tere Qurban.

Zamana Lakh Mukhalif Ho Ruk Nahi Sakta.
Keh Fatima Ki Dua Hai Hussain Ka Matam.
Yazid Iss Se Bari Our Kya Hai Teri Shikast.
Keh Tere Ghar Mein Bapa Hai Hussain Ka Matam.

2

Jahan Kahin Bhi Bapa Hai Hussain Ka Matam.
Khabar Nahi Hai Yeh Fatway Farosh Mufti Ko.
Ali Ke Ghar Se Chala Hai Hussain Ka Matam.

3

Jo Hath Karta Raha Hai Hussain Ka Matam.
Aye Bint-e-Fatima Zahra Teri Atta Ke Tofail.
Humein Naseeb Howa Hai Hussain Ka Matam.

4
Baroz-e-Hashar Khabar Lein Gay Oss Ki Peygamber.
Jisay Khabar Nahi Kya Hai Hussain Ka Matam.
Wilaye Aal-e-Nabi Ki Tarha Se:MIR HASAN:.
Mere Lahu Mein Mila Hai Hussain Ka Matam.

Siwaye Chand Aik Zahoor Ki Sab Alamatein Pori Ho Chuki Hain.

Yaad e Sehwan

Guzashta Saal Dewano Ke Yeh Parwaz Ke Din They.
Tha Unn Ka Urs Yani Hazrat-e-Shahbaz Ke Din They.
Har Ik Molai Ka Tha Inn Dino Goya Hadaf Sehwan.
Thi Aisi Gaunj Naron Ki Keh Jaisay Ho Najaf Sehwan.
Tha Misal-e-Shama Roza Our Sabhi Parwaney Yakja They.
Ali Ke Lal Ke Dar Par Kayi Moti Ikatha They.

2
Kahin Matam Kahin Nobat Kahin Majlis Kahin Nohay.
Dhamalon Ki Kahin Aawaz Par Lagtay Hoye Narey.
Magar Iss Saal Aye Mere Khuda Sunsaan Hai Roza.
Nahi Hai Aik Bhi Zair Bohat Veeran Hai Roza.
Jo Dil Mein Raaz They Hum Raaz Ko Apne Bataney They.
Bohat Se Maslay Main Ne Qalandar Ko Sunanay They.

3

Hamesha Hosla Mujh Ko Mere Saein Se Milta Tha.
Mere Malik Bata De Ab Shifa Paney Kahan Jaon.
Woh Dar Tu Band Hai Ab Hath Phailanay Kahan Jaon.
Achanak Dil Ki Dharkan Ne Takhayul Mein Khalal Wala.
Achanak Meri Na Umeedi Ko Umeed Mein Badla.

4
Kaha Dil Ne Keh Har Ik Qalb Pe Qudrat Hai Sehwan Ki.
Issay Dharkan Nahi Samjho Keh Yeh Nobat Hai Sehwan Ki.
Balaon Se Sada Aazad Tha Aazad Hai Sehwan.
Malangon Ke Dilon Mein Aaj Bhi Aabad Hai Sehwan.
